NORAD ID: 25117
Int'l Code: 1997-084F
Launch date: December 23, 1997
Source: ORBCOMM (ORB)
Launch site: Pegasus launched from Eastern Range Air Space (ERAS)

ORBCOMM FM-5 was part of a commercial venture to provide global messaging services using a constellation of 26 low-Earth orbiting satellites. The planned system is designed to handle up to 5 million messages from users utilizing small, portable terminals to transmit and receive messages directly to the satellites.
